target_customer: Creators and individuals who want social posts generated from their existing accounts and media; the current site targets marketers making AI UGC video ads
problem: Producing steady social content (posts, carousels, short video) is slow. Remix generates it from connected accounts, photos, voice notes and messages.
business_model: Consumer app with likely subscription (not stated in sources)

founders.name: Sam Kaplan
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked with LLMs since the GPT-3 beta and has built apps since middle school.

competitors.name: PostSyncer
competitors.what: Publishing and scheduling across 10+ platforms with AI content creation

competitors.name: PostWizard AI
competitors.what: iOS app for creating social posts in minutes

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting social accounts, ingesting media, and orchestrating many parallel agents for copy, selection and editing is standard LLM application engineering with some hard parts around video.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar AI post generators launched in 2026 and no data or network moat is shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown; no incumbent action found in sources.

market_need_then: Creators and brands face constant demand for social content; the many 2026 launches of AI post tools show demand but also crowding.

branding.domain_note: YC contact address uses remix.re while the website redirects remix.re to remix.is (fetched 2026-11); exact .com not used.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct: The fastest way to create great AI UGC, Stop the scroll

branding.community_and_virality: Site shows an Instagram post with 1.3M views as a result example; no press on the brand itself found.

brand_strength.rationale: Remix is a common word shared with a web framework, a gaming startup and other apps, so search confusion is likely and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Remix is a Winter 2026 company still early with no exit or reported shutdown. The YC description is a social post generator for individuals, while the website fetched in November 2026 describes an AI UGC video ad tool, which suggests a shift toward marketers, though no dated pivot statement was found. Crowded category and a generic name are the main risks.
notes: Unverified: one aggregator (vcbacked.co/company/remix) lists $500K pre-seed in March 2026 with Y Combinator; no second source. Other Remix funding in search results ($5M seed, gaming company) belongs to different companies. Team size listed 0 in dataset. The App Store listing names Resonate Software Inc as copyright holder, and YC lists a separate Resonate company with Sam Kaplan, so the entity relationship is unclear. The apparent shift to AI UGC ads is inferred from the website and is not a sourced pivot. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (2026-03) is recorded from VCBacked alone (single database); a second search found no other source.
